themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, interact with systems, and make decisions in research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that aid developers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code, including discussions on their capabilities and limitations.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights AI-powered platforms, software, and frameworks designed to assist researchers in various stages of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing the use of AI to condense large amounts of text, research papers, or conversations into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Focuses on comparisons, reviews, and assessments of different AI tools for UX, research, and product development.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Explores how AI is changing jobs, requiring new skills, and affecting employment across various industries.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers the application of AI specifically within the domains of UX design, user research, and product design processes.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles dealing with the creation and use of AI-generated personas or user profiles for testing and research.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Discusses how AI tools and techniques are being used by product managers to inform decision-making, prioritize features, and understand market needs.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the research, development, and user experience aspects of conversational AI and chatbots.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
